newsitem.title: RUSSIA: St Petersburg Telephone shares auctioned.
newsitem.headline: St Petersburg Telephone shares auctioned.

text.p: A 1.2 percent stake in Peterburgskaya Telefonnaya Syet, sold at auction on December 11, fetched an average 5,628.188 roubles ($1.02) per share, a stock exchange official said.

Twelve lots of 0.1 percent each of the shares of St Petersburg Telephone, a total 5,597,820 shares, were sold, said the deputy head of the clearing center of the Commodities and Stock Exchange St Petersburg, Alexei Sergeyev.
Shares in the company were quoted on the Russian Trading System at $1.10/$1.28 after trade on Sunday, a working day in Russia.
